cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Delegate Downward
cards.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You're my deputy. You'll answer the inspector's complaints. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Most of them concern decisions you made.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. You handle the details below decision-making level.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The inspector wants whoever signs the replies at tomorrow's hearing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign as deputy, then. You can represent me without giving the impression we're equals.

mechanism: A puts complaint handling beneath A decision-making rank but concedes support and wording to persuade B to accept the subordinate hearing burden.
confusable: Unlike neutral delegation, A uses rank to transfer unwelcome consequences of A own decisions; confidence depends on B cooperation and negotiated backing.
comparison: Inspector responses and a hearing differ from after-hours building supervision.
seedUse: Use canonical D53-b deputy/decisions/signature/hearing with S02-b adapting role terms to keep a helper.
